en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's almost like a museum or library...
It's huge...and a little eerie...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are various objects stored in shelves
and cases. Some of them seem very rare.

It would appear this is my lab.
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Anthropologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab.

It's so wonderful, my face contorts with glee.
Not even university labs are so well-stocked.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...who brought all this stuff here?

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose there's no point thinking about
it. Nothing in this place makes sense.

Nee-heehee... This is the first time I've seen
Kiyo get so mad.

He's scary when he's mad. If he tore out
my nerves, I think I might cry!

This is truly amazing...
Not even university labs are so well-stocked.

Having all this to myself gives me some 
complicated feelings, as I am a researcher.

Calling on the dead out of curiosity
would only be a blasphemy.

One must call on them...
only at the appropriate time.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a large wooden dog statue on the
pedestal. It looks pretty old.

<CLT=cltMIND>It has some kind of strange power to it...
It makes me shiver just looking at it.
Th-That's...!

Ooh! Can it be!? I never could've dreamed 
that <CLT=cltSTRONG>this<CLT=cltNORMAL> truly existed!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo, quivering with excitement, reached out
to that peculiar dog statue...

<CLT=cltMIND>and slowly removed the white fabric
on the pedestal.

Ooh! There's even a cage!
This is perfect!

Perfect? For what?
What are the statue and cage for?

Kehehe... I never thought I would be able
to touch the real thing in all my life.
Today is a momentous day, indeed...

<CLT=cltMIND>He's so focused that
he's not even listening.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a large wooden dog statue on the
pedestal. It looks pretty old.

<CLT=cltMIND>It has some kind of strange power to it...
It makes me shiver just looking at it.

Kehehe... I never thought I would be able
to touch the real thing in all my life.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo seems pretty focused...
Window
Cloth
Cage
<CLT=cltMIND>There's something in this case...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a golden katana...
How beautiful.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's rusted in places but looks about a
yard long and still sharp.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that real gold...?
It's probably valuable...

Kehehe... You were drawn to that katana, I see.
However, it is merely coated with gold leaf.
Ah, so it's not made of gold.

That said...that katana has immense 
anthropological value.

In certain rural areas, katanas used to defeat
generals in wars are worshipped as gods...

That is one such katana. It is an extremely 
precious relic necessary to spread—

Whoa! That's a super rad katana!
I wanna take a look-see!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi suddenly popped up between us
and grabbed the katana from the case.
Wait, you mustn't touch it without—
Don't worry, I'll be super careful with it!
...Would I lie to you!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi completely ignored Kiyo's warning
and unsheathed the sword.

Now this katana is the real deal. It's even
gold-plated for that authentic look!

Hmm, I see... It could also be used
as a murder weapon.

Kokichi...that is an extremely precious relic.
Please do not treat it so lightly, or...
...I will tear out your nerves.

O-Okay, I get it... Please don't make such
scary threats...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi slid the sword back into its
sheath and handed it back to Kiyo.

Ew! My hands are all sticky!
That gold plating flakes off so easily!

But I guess that's what makes it an
authentic katana!

Yes...it is very old, so the gold leaf 
comes off easily.

In any event, please do not touch things without
permission. These are all precious relics.
If you do so again, I will tear out your nerves.

I-I get it... The scary threats really
aren't necessary...

<CLT=cltMIND>...So that's what Kiyo sounds like
when he gets angry.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's something in this case...

<CLT=cltMIND>A beautiful golden katana...
It looks about a yard long and still sharp.

That katana has immense 
anthropological value.

That's why I would prefer it be treated with 
respect. If something *does* happen to it...
...I will tear out your nerves.

<CLT=cltMIND>...So that's what Kiyo sounds like
when he gets angry.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's packed with books and scrolls...
They're all weathered and old.

I don't think I could read all of these
if I had a million years...
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a book in the display case.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bookcases were full of books,
but I imagine this one is special.
This one...looks like it was bound by hand.
Can it truly be!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Unlike his usual quiet self, Kiyo shouted
and ran over to me with an alarmed expression.

<CLT=cltMIND>With steady, careful hands, he took
the book from its showcase.

It *is*... H-How amazing!
It's actually real!
What is that book, Kiyo?
It is...an extremely precious document.

This book is a history of the fabled <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog
Village<CLT=cltNORMAL>, said to have been destroyed long ago.
The "Caged Dog Village"?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village<CLT=cltNORMAL> had a reputation
for using many dark arts and spells...

The village was destroyed at the hands of a
feudal lord who feared their power...

But one girl—the lone survivor—risked 
her life to write this book.
Which means...this is all her handwriting.

This book is an extremely precious one-of-a-kind
relic that has been soaked in her bitter grudge.

One of a kind?
That *is* valuable...

On top of that, since this book has such
a <CLT=cltSTRONG>reputation<CLT=cltNORMAL>, there are few copies.

Since I was fortunate enough to obtain one of
those copies, I have already memorized it.

Kehehe... But I never thought I'd be able to lay
eyes on the real one... What a trick of fate.
Ah, Kiyo...what did you mean by <CLT=cltSTRONG>reputation<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

The rumor goes that the spells and dark arts 
inscribed in this book are extremely potent...

They surpass the comprehension of people
who live in a world of science and technology.

That is why...it was buried in the darkness.
Along with the entire Caged Dog Village.

But it seems those were no mere rumors.
I can feel power seeping out from this book.

The deep-seated grudge of a girl whose village
was destroyed...permeates every letter...

<CLT=cltMIND>...This is getting weird.
I think I should just...end the conversation.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a book in the display case.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bookcases were full of books,
but I imagine this one is special.
Kehehe... I never imagined I'd find it here.

This book is a history of the fabled <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog
Village<CLT=cltNORMAL>, said to have been destroyed long ago.

I never thought I'd be able to lay eyes on
the real one... What a trick of fate.

Kehehe... I can feel power seeping out 
from this book.

<CLT=cltMIND>...This is getting weird.
I think I should just...end the conversation.

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel as though the only thing I've learned
is that I've learned nothing about this lab.

By the way, Shuichi... Would you like to 
lend your ear to the voices of the dead?
...The what?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Caged Dog Village documents<CLT=cltNORMAL> contain 
many dark arts unique to that village.

Of all of them, the one I find most interesting
is a seance called "<CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...

In fact, the wooden dog statue and iron cage
over there are to be used in this very seance.

Kehehe... To discover it exists is surprising 
enough, but to actually have it before me...

So...would you like to try? Let us converse
with the dead using <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL>, shall we?

Ah...no thanks.
I don't have any interest in the occult...

Now, now... You mustn't dismiss it as
simply the occult...

Some matters you refer to as the occult are of
the utmost importance to anthropology.

Dismissing things you don't understand as the
occult is a defilement to all cultures, yes?
Ah, yes, but <CLT=cltSTRONG>talking to the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>—

Haven't you ever wanted to speak 
with the dead?
...Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>Speak...with the dead...

<CLT=cltMIND>If it were possible, I suppose...
I'd like to talk to <CLT=cltSTRONG>her<CLT=cltMIND> one more—
No. No, I decline.

Even if it were possible to speak with the dead...
I don't have anything to say. Not yet.

The only thing I'd want to say is...
We escaped. We finally got out of here...

Kehehe...that determination is beautiful.
Perhaps you are correct.

Calling on the dead out of curiosity
would only be a blasphemy.

One must call on them...
only at the appropriate time.
<CLT=cltMIND>I felt a shiver up my spine.
